# Cachy Swipe

> Cachy Swipe is an MIT-licensed native KWin effect for switching between open windows with three-finger touchpad swipes on KDE Plasma Wayland. It uses KDE's native Alt+Tab switcher and supports KWin 6.8.x.

Version: 0.4.0. Implementation: C++20 with Qt 6 and KWin. Installation instructions target CachyOS and Arch Linux. This file is a concise documentation index; it is not a crawler configuration file.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project facts, compatibility, installation, activation, sensitivity settings, FAQ, removal and tests.
- [Publishing guide](docs/PUBLISHING.md): GitHub description, repository topics and search-discovery guidance.
- [License](LICENSE): MIT license.

## Behavior and compatibility

- Three-finger swipes select windows in a grid of up to four columns: left/right changes column, up/down changes row. Four fingers can be configured.
- The selected window is activated when the gesture ends normally.
- Escape or gesture cancellation closes the switcher without activating another window.
- Selection follows the two-dimensional finger trace and the centered rows, with a stability margin and hard stops on each row and column; it never wraps or selects empty cells.
- Window order and appearance come from KDE's native TabBox. No Alt+Tab keypresses are synthesized.
- Supported environment: KDE Plasma on Wayland with KWin 6.8.x. Other KWin minor versions need a private-ABI compatibility review.
- GNOME, Hyprland and X11 are not supported.
- Two-finger scrolling and virtual-desktop switching are outside this effect's scope.

## Configuration

Settings file: ~/.config/kwinrc. Group: [Effect-cachyswipe].

- SwipeDistance: default 120; range 80–4000 KWin gesture units. Lower means more sensitive.
- FingerCount: default 3; supported values 3 and 4.
- ReverseDirection: default true; false reverses horizontal movement. Vertical movement is unaffected.
- GridNavigation: default true; use with the included Cachy Swipe Grid layout. False restores horizontal list navigation.
- The Cachy Swipe Grid layout is used for normal keyboard Alt+Tab too.
- Existing explicit settings override these defaults.
- Reload with: qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /Effects org.kde.kwin.Effects.reconfigureEffect cachyswipe

## Implementation references

- [Build configuration](CMakeLists.txt): Version, dependencies and KWin 6.8.x requirement.
- [Effect implementation](src/cachyswipe.cpp): Configuration, input handling and native TabBox control.
- [Gesture math](src/swipe_index.h): Proportional selection, stability margin and end stops.
- [TabBox bridge](src/tabbox_bridge.h): Private KWin interface used by the effect.
- [Integration checks](tests/integration-session.sh): Defaults, overrides, selection, confirmation, cancellation and boundary checks.
- [Automatic rebuild](scripts/auto_rebuild.py): Opt-in per-user timer rebuilds and tests after system dependency changes, then activates only against a matching running KWin. Setup requires one new login; no sudo or automatic source downloads.

- [Four-column switcher layout](tabbox/cachy-swipe-grid/contents/ui/main.qml): Native TabBox grid with classic large icons, scrolling and keyboard navigation.
